newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India GDRs edge higher on Bombay rise.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India GDRs edge higher on Bombay rise.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts edged higher Wednesday, with broad-based support for blue chips and second line shares, dealers said.
GDRs tracked a continuing rally in Bombay, where stocks hit a 33-month high.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.38 points higher at 90.58, up 0.42 percent, with the premium over the local market at 24.90 percent from 24.89 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index rose 33.04 points to 4,333.90.
Hindalco gained 75 cents to $36.50/$37.50 and Telco lost five cents to $15.00/$15.75.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index closed 1.40 points higher, or 1.81 percent, at 78.47 points, a premium of 39.41 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index finished 5.57 points lower at 125.13, representing a discount to the local market of 3.84 percent.
